# Captured Samsung appliance fixtures

These JSON files are real OCF resource captures from Samsung appliances, copied
verbatim from the **localthings** project for use as test oracles here.

- Source: https://github.com/mbillow/localthings  (`tests/fixtures/`)
- Upstream commit: f86a819c4371be1db3d21e1e06c44b4620dbce33
- License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Marc Billow). See upstream LICENSE.

They are used here only as fixtures to drive hardware-free tests and to derive
capability mappings. No endorsement or affiliation is implied.
